name: 2DPHYS Atomic Workbench
description: Build atomic structures in virtual reality and watch them move and conduct. Graphene, graphite, MoS₂, hBN, nanotubes, C₆₀, nanodiamond, benzene and molecular junctions - or attach any main-group atom to any atom, with valence rules. Molecular dynamics with real potentials, electron transport (transmission, current, bond currents) from the live geometry, tweezers, annihilator, seated movement and hands. Runs on a Meta Quest (standalone or via a PC) - also see-through, on a real table in your room - and on the desktop with a mouse.
